title: Microsoft Purview: auto-labeling for legacy .doc, .xls and .ppt files (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The roadmap facts, existing policy controls and licensing statements are supported. The legacy-format default and rollout details remain unpublished; the summary should clarify that the missing switch is one specific to legacy formats, not the existing policy controls.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans server-side auto-labeling support for Word .doc files.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt).

claims.fix: Replace 'no admin switch is documented' with 'no admin switch specific to legacy-format support is documented' so the summary cannot be mistaken for an absence of the policy controls shown below.

claims.claim: Learn advises running auto-labeling policies in simulation before turning them on.
claims.quote: Because the user doesn't interact with the labeling process, auto-labeling policies don't support recommended labeling — instead, run the policy in simulation before you turn it on to help ensure correct labeling.

claims.claim: The Purview portal path Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Turn on policy enables enforcement after simulation.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies. ... Select your policy ... When you're ready to run the policy without simulation, select the Turn on policy option.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -Mode Enable enables policy actions.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the auto-labeling policy that you want to modify. ... Name ... The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the auto-labeling policy. ... Enable: The policy is enabled for actions and notifications.

claims.claim: TestWithoutNotifications is the test mode.
claims.quote: TestWithoutNotifications: An audit mode where no actions are taken, and no notifications are sent (Test mode).

claims.claim: The Purview portal path Solutions > Information Protection > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > policy > Edit policy > Choose locations where you want to apply the label reaches location configuration.
claims.quote: For a policy in the Off section, select the Edit policy button. ... For the page Choose locations where you want to apply the label: Select and specify locations for Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

claims.claim: Set-AutoSensitivityLabelPolicy -Identity "<policy name>" -AddSharePointLocation "<site URL>" adds an included SharePoint site.
claims.quote: The AddSharePointLocation parameter specifies the SharePoint sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the SharePointLocation parameter. You identify the site by its URL value.

claims.claim: AddOneDriveLocation is the corresponding parameter for adding OneDrive locations.
claims.quote: The AddOneDriveLocation parameter specifies the OneDrive sites to add to the list of included sites when you aren't using the value All for the OneDriveLocation parameter. You identify the site by its URL value.
